title: More than 100 years ago, red mangroves were introduced to Hawaii; now crews are trying to...
summary_full: In Hawaii, environmental teams are embarking on an ambitious project to eradicate invasive red mangroves, targeting nearly two miles of waterways in Kailua. This initiative is vital for preserving endangered native waterbirds while simultaneously addressing environmental degradation. The involvement of community volunteers and organizations is essential for this extensive, multi-year effort, funded by national foundations and set to commence in September 2026.
